privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.startParagraph: This Privacy Policy describes what information SebaWeather ("the App", "we") collects, how we use it, and what choices you have regarding it. By using SebaWeather, you agree to the practices described here.

firstItem.title: 1. Information collected
firstItem.startParagraph: To provide the weather notification service, we collect and store the following data in Firebase (Firestore):

firstListItem.title: Favorite cities:
firstListItem.paragraph: the cities you add to track the weather or receive notifications.

secondListItem.title: FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) token:
secondListItem.paragraph: a unique identifier generated by your browser/device that allows us to send you push notifications. This token does not, by itself, contain any personally identifiable information.

thirdListItem.title: Preferred language:
thirdListItem.paragraph: the language configured in the App to display content correctly.

fourthListItem.title: Notification times:
fourthListItem.paragraph: the time windows you set to receive weather alerts for your favorite cities.

fifthListItem.title: Date and time added:
fifthListItem.paragraph: the moment you added a city or subscription, used to sort and manage your preferences.

firstItem.lastParagraph: We do not collect names, email addresses, phone numbers, or any other personally identifiable information.

secondItem.title: 2. How we use this information
secondItem.startParagraph: We use the data exclusively to:
secondItem.firstListItem: Send you push notifications about the weather for your favorite cities, at the times you've configured.
secondItem.secondListItem: Display the App in your preferred language.
secondItem.thirdListItem: Keep your favorite cities and their settings synced across sessions.
secondItem.fourthListItem: Diagnose technical issues related to sending notifications (for example, invalid or expired tokens).
secondItem.lastParagraph: We do not sell, rent, or share this information with third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.

thirdItem.title: 3. Where data is stored
thirdItem.secondSpan: services provided by Google. Scheduled notifications are sent via an automated function (cron job) hosted on
thirdItem.lastParagraph: Google/Firebase may process this data according to its own privacy policy, available at

fourthItem.title: 4. Data retention
fourthItem.paragraph: We retain your favorite cities, FCM token, language, and notification times for as long as you keep your subscription active. If you remove a favorite city, disable notifications, or your FCM token becomes invalid (for example, by uninstalling the App, clearing your browser data, or revoking notification permissions), the corresponding record will become obsolete.

fifthItem.title: 5. Your rights and choices
fifthItem.firstItem: Remove a favorite city from the App, which will delete its associated record in Firestore.
fifthItem.secondItem: Disable push notifications from your browser/device settings or from within the App itself.
fifthItem.thirdItem: Change the App's language at any time.
fifthItem.fourthItem: Request full deletion of stored data by writing to
fifthItem.fourthItem.cont: with the name of the saved city and the approximate date it was added to favorites.

sixthItem.title: 6. Changes to this policy
sixthItem.paragraph: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected with a new "Last updated" date at the top of this page.
